memories.content:
Session summary: 2 requests on branch feat/cors, {{DATE}} 09:00–09:40 UTC.
Requests:
- the dashboard can't call the API from the browser, CORS errors
- 대시보드 도메인만 허용해줘
Final response:
Added a CORS middleware in internal/httpapi/cors.go that allows only https://app.acme.dev and echoes the Origin; credentials are allowed so the session cookie is sent.
CORS is configured in internal/httpapi/cors.go to allow only the dashboard origin https://app.acme.dev with credentials enabled.

Session summary: 2 requests on branch feat/cache, {{DATE}} 10:00–11:00 UTC.
Requests:
- add caching for merchant lookups
- use Redis
Final response:
Added a Redis cache for merchant lookups in internal/cache/redis.go with a 10-minute TTL.
Merchant lookups are cached in Redis (internal/cache/redis.go) with a 10-minute TTL.

Session summary: 2 requests on branch chore/drop-redis, {{DATE}} 03:00–03:50 UTC.
Requests:
- Redis is one more thing to run, can we drop it
- 인메모리 캐시로 바꿔줘
Final response:
Replaced the Redis merchant cache with an in-process TTL cache (internal/cache/memcache.go) using golang-lru with a 5-minute expiry; removed the Redis dependency.
Merchant lookups are cached in-process with golang-lru and a 5-minute expiry (internal/cache/memcache.go); Redis was removed.

Session summary: 2 requests on branch fix/http-timeout, {{DATE}} 06:00–06:35 UTC.
Requests:
- calls to Stripe hang forever sometimes
- add a timeout
Final response:
Gave the Stripe HTTP client a 10-second timeout and wrapped outbound calls with a context deadline in internal/stripe/client.go.
The Stripe HTTP client uses a 10-second timeout with a context deadline on outbound calls (internal/stripe/client.go).

Session summary: 2 requests on branch feat/theme, {{DATE}} 07:00–07:45 UTC.
Requests:
- add a dark mode toggle
- 새로고침해도 유지되게 해줘
Final response:
Added a theme toggle that stores the choice in localStorage and applies a data-theme attribute on <html>; Tailwind dark: variants pick it up. The default follows prefers-color-scheme.
The theme choice is persisted in localStorage and applied as a data-theme attribute on the html element; Tailwind dark: variants read it.

Session summary: 2 requests on branch feat/forms, {{DATE}} 10:00–10:55 UTC.
Requests:
- standardize how we build forms
- validation should be typed
Final response:
Adopted react-hook-form with zod resolvers; shared field components live in src/components/form and all new forms validate with a zod schema.
Build forms with react-hook-form and validate with zod schemas; shared field components are in src/components/form.

Session summary: 2 requests on branch fix/serve-latency, {{DATE}} 04:00–05:10 UTC.
Requests:
- the scoring endpoint is slow under load
- 배치로 묶어서 처리해봐
Final response:
Added micro-batching to the serving handler (serving/app.py): requests within a 20ms window are scored together; p99 latency dropped from 180ms to 60ms.
The serving handler (serving/app.py) micro-batches requests within a 20ms window before scoring to reduce p99 latency.
Training data is read from Parquet files in the s3://acme-ml/churn/ bucket, partitioned by date.
